title: DynaWeave: Learning to Adapt through Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.29443v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use tools to complete tasks in stateful environments. However, many training environments remain largely static apart from changes caused by the agent's own actions, whereas external events introduced by other users, services, or sudden contingencies in real environments can invalidate ongoing plans. To address this gap, we introduce DynaWeave, an automated synthesis framework that transforms existing static tasks into verifiable dynamic scenarios. The framework generates exogenous events relevant to each task, covering changes in task requirements, environment state, and external information. It uses directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) to represent dependencies between events and an execution engine to activate them during agent interaction. translated_title: DynaWeave：通过动态场景合成学习适应
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地使用工具在有状态环境中完成任务。然而，除了智能体自身行动引起的变化之外，许多训练环境在很大程度上保持静态，而真实环境中由其他用户、服务或突发意外引入的外部事件可能会使正在执行的计划失效。为解决这一差距，我们提出了DynaWeave，一个将现有静态任务转化为可验证动态场景的自动化合成框架。该框架为每个任务生成相关的外生事件，涵盖任务需求、环境状态和外部信息的变化。它使用有向无环图（DAG）来表示事件之间的依赖关系，并通过执行引擎在智能体交互过程中激活这些事件。动态验证器仅修改受实际发生事件影响的评估检查，并保留所有其他检查。使用DynaWeave，我们收集了2,095（个……摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出DynaWeave自动化框架，通过生成具有依赖关系的外生事件将静态LLM智能体任务转化为可验证的动态场景，从而训练和评估智能体应对环境突变的能力。
